mentions.description: A deterministic structural verification service for regulated documents and workflow artifacts. It compares a reference version against an evaluated version and produces a reproducible evidence package — a hash ledger plus concordance/divergence witnesses — that can be reviewed offline, using no AI or similarity scoring, and is intended to stand outside the producing system.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just launched a deterministic structural verification service for regulated docs and workflow artifacts. It compares a reference vs an evaluated version and produces a reproducible evidence package (hash ledger + concordance/divergence witnesses) that can be reviewed offline. No AI, no similarity scoring—just deterministic outputs meant to stand outside the producing system.
